historical_record.description: A 50-foot-wide, 104-foot-deep vacant lot stood on the north side of 24th Street west of York Street, in the 24th Street shopping district, zoned C-2. The City Planning Commission found the city's acquisition of the vacant lot on the north side of 24th Street west of York Street for a mini-park to be in conformity with the Master Plan.
